views.title: Agentic laboratory and trust boundaries
views.subtitle: Deterministic meta-controller FSM; LLM roles behind a tool firewall; hashed out-of-process evaluator; commit-reveal seal; registry and rendered claims (§7.1–7.13, §10.1–10.6)

nodes.label: CIO + CRO
nodes.sublabel: sign the AnalysisContract; Board/owner if STRUCTURAL
nodes.detail: Co-sign the contract at T−22 (G0). STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY also needs Board (and owner where the mandate is involved) sign-off. Adopting an AmendmentDraft requires new SignOff objects, which no agent tool can create (§10.1).

nodes.label: CRO office
nodes.sublabel: custodian of the seal salt; dispositions G1 findings
nodes.detail: The seal service runs under the CRO account and holds the per-campaign salt (TB4). The CRO dispositions the family-B design reviewer's findings at T−21 (G1).

nodes.label: MRM
nodes.sublabel: engine validation, release hashes; approves metrics
nodes.detail: Engine validation, release hashes, revalidation on any model, prompt or tool change; approves metric-registry changes; inventories the lab as an AI system; the calibration plane and the sealed SYN truth (TB8) are readable by MRM only.

nodes.label: AI governance function
nodes.sublabel: allowed model families; LLM materiality tiers
nodes.detail: Decides allowed model families and LLM materiality tiers (high: drafter, reviewer, translator; medium: writer, auditor, red team, extractors, seats; low: ideators); sees LLM call records and admission tests; acts through the agents configuration.

nodes.label: RACI owners
nodes.sublabel: answer escalations routed by the contract's raci
nodes.detail: escalate(kind, question, blocking, proposed_assumption, severity) routes to the RACI owner named in the contract (AnalysisContract.raci).

nodes.label: Operators
nodes.sublabel: run jobs; a flag enables holding-level prompts
nodes.owner: TPA desk quant developers; data/platform engineer
nodes.detail: Decide nothing about the portfolio; run jobs via the CLI, read-only MCP tools and CI. Holding-level prompt content needs an explicit operator flag for a role and data class declared in llm_policy.

nodes.label: TB5 decision boundary
nodes.sublabel: SignOff only by authenticated humans; AI never votes

nodes.label: AnalysisContract
nodes.sublabel: planes, gates, budgets, llm_policy, raci, hashes
nodes.detail: Frozen pydantic model: mandate_mode (B by default), mode NORMAL / EXEC_RECOVERY / STRUCT_RECOVERY, recovery plan, pricing_scenario, signoffs, frozen_questions (8–15 per Tier-A item), objective, tier1, floor, actions (lenses per group), anchor P0@hash, controls, planes (with the seal commitment), gates, budgets, horizons, operating_points, llm_policy (family, model, effort per role; prompt hashes), raci, engine/config/snapshot/scenario hashes. Rules: owner_signoff iff mandate_mode ≠ B; OWNER_PROPOSAL outputs never reach cards, envelopes or FTP; STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY needs Board sign-off; ni_comparator = RESTORED_BASELINE whenever mode ≠ NORMAL.

nodes.label: data: bitemporal store
nodes.sublabel: freeze → StateSnapshot / BeliefSet @hash; taint
nodes.detail: Schemas, bitemporal store, adapters, freeze and taint. Only synth may create data; everything derived from it is tainted. The T−23 freeze produces StateSnapshot@hash and BeliefSet@hash (G2).

nodes.label: registry
nodes.sublabel: append-only, hash-chained; a RunManifest per run
nodes.detail: Append-only, hash-chained run/metric/claim/forecast/decision store (SQLite + Parquet). Every run writes a RunManifest: engine git SHA and tree hash, config, scenario-set, belief, snapshot and census hashes, seed spawn keys, plane, cache keys, solver and options, thread count, pinned numpy/numba/highspy versions, and per LLM call the served model id, prompt and response hashes, tokens, cost and any fallback event. Manifests map to W3C PROV and OpenTelemetry spans; re-running one reproduces the numbers bit for bit.

nodes.label: metric registry
nodes.sublabel: metric_id, value, unit, plane, CI, range, MC error
nodes.detail: Every number the IC can see is a metric instance (metric_id, run_id, value, unit, plane, CI, model range, MC error, scenario hash). A definition records code reference and hash, unit, aggregation, CI method, world-range method, ICD-203 applicability and owner; changing a definition creates a new metric id.

nodes.label: Provenance DAG
nodes.sublabel: recommendation → spec → attempts → bundles → worker
nodes.detail: recommendation → spec → attempts → bundles → mechanism references → worker, cycle and memory hash (paper l.1410-1412).

nodes.label: TB7 synthetic vs real
nodes.sublabel: is_synthetic + data_class on every row; mixing = error

nodes.label: TB8 truth seal
nodes.sublabel: SYN ground truth readable only by MRM validation jobs

nodes.label: Meta-controller
nodes.sublabel: plain-Python FSM; re-validates submit_* (≤ 3 retries)
nodes.detail: Deterministic orchestration (P9): 2 workers by default, configurable to 4 (ADR-17). Every role ends with a submit_<artifact> tool whose output the meta-controller re-validates with Pydantic; ≤ 3 retries on validation failure. Transcripts are append-only (§11.2).

nodes.label: Tool firewall
nodes.sublabel: per-state allowlists; no file, shell, code or network
nodes.detail: Per-state tool allowlists enforced by the meta-controller; strict JSON Schema (additionalProperties: false). Agents hold no file, shell, code or network tool (TB3).

nodes.label: LLM gateway
nodes.sublabel: sole egress; redaction filter; frozen hashed prompts
nodes.detail: Only process with network egress (HTTPS to the LLM provider). The redaction filter tokenizes sensitive fields (owner fiscal items, counterparties, GP names). Role prompts are frozen, versioned and hashed in llm_policy; any prompt, model or tool change reruns the evaluation suite. A refusal fallback that collapses author and reviewer into one family triggers re-routing.

nodes.label: Budgets + deflation
nodes.sublabel: 24 cycles, ≤ 650 evals, $50/$200; α-investing, DSR
nodes.detail: Defaults [I]: 24 idea cycles (12 per worker); ≤ 650 counted search evaluations; ≤ 2 EvalRequests per attempt; tuning jobs ≤ 24 counted CMA-ES evaluations in the declared box; LLM spend $50 soft / $200 hard per cycle; ≈20 core-hours. Error control: decaying-memory generalized α-investing across cycles (W₀ = 0.05, payout 0.05, escalate below 0.005), Holm within a cycle. The IC sees N_eval incl. failures, clustered N_eff, the deflated search improvement (DSR), the search-to-final optimism gap and PBO.

nodes.label: Campaign memory
nodes.sublabel: per-campaign search heuristic; never evidence
nodes.detail: Append-only event log plus a ≤ 300-word conclusions paragraph per worker; shared at cycle boundaries, pruned every 8 cycles [I]; writes close at SELECTION; archived read-only at CLOSED; never loads into another campaign. The writer, auditor and seats cannot read it; the validator rejects any memo citing it. Institutional memory lives only in the forecast registry and the decision log.

nodes.label: escalate + assumption log
nodes.sublabel: blocking call pauses worker; assumptions tag outputs
nodes.detail: A blocking call pauses the worker (high-materiality roles always block); a non-blocking call proceeds under a logged assumption that tags every downstream artifact and prints in the memo and the pack appendix. 'Data insufficient' is an admissible output.

nodes.label: claims renderer
nodes.sublabel: {{m:metric_id|fmt}} → value, unit, plane, CI, range
nodes.detail: Writers use typed placeholders {{m:<metric_id>|<format>}}; the renderer fills each with value, unit, plane label, CI, model range and ICD-203 word (ADR-20).

nodes.label: claims validator
nodes.sublabel: rejects literal digits, wrong plane, overclaims
nodes.detail: Rejects literal digits outside a whitelist (dates, section numbers); unknown or wrong-plane metrics; improvement verbs on NOT_QUALIFIED or NOT_ASSESSED results or within MC error; probabilities without a range; citations to memory; synthetic numbers attributed to ADIC; claim coverage below 1.

nodes.sublabel: lint_report on the contract, beside the reviewer (G1)

nodes.label: TB1 data perimeter
nodes.sublabel: holdings stay local; redaction filter at the gateway

nodes.detail: G0 in recovery: u*, d0, IIS and glide path; Board/owner sign-off if STRUCTURAL.

nodes.sublabel: IdeaBundles from 2 workers on the search plane
nodes.detail: Ideators submit typed IdeaBundles: anchored residuals, action packages or overlay structures.

nodes.label: SCREENING
nodes.sublabel: counted search evals; G4 correct, G5 selection
nodes.detail: Search stops when the budget is spent, after 6 cycles without a promotion, or when no column has a positive robust reduced cost.

nodes.label: SELECTION
nodes.sublabel: ≤ 4 finalists: incumbent, ≤ 3 cells, C_H (T−13)
nodes.detail: Finalists: at most four, the incumbent, the best of up to three distinct MAP-Elites archive cells, and C_H (H's quarter-1 package followed by P0) always. Memory writes close.

nodes.label: SEALED
nodes.sublabel: final plane run once (T−12)
nodes.detail: Sealed run once on the final plane; certification against T6 bands; G6 labels.

nodes.label: RETROSPECTIVE
nodes.sublabel: controls, switch-off null, ablations (T−11)
nodes.detail: Controls at 3/5/10 years, switch-off null, single-change ablations, red team, one bootstrap rerun.

nodes.label: MEMO
nodes.sublabel: briefs drafted as placeholders (T−9…T−8)
nodes.detail: G7 on exit: claim coverage = 1, plane labels, ICD-203 words, P14 fields, validator pass.

nodes.label: REVIEW
nodes.sublabel: family-B audit + human countersignature (T−9…T−8)

nodes.sublabel: computed seats, minority reports (T−7)
nodes.detail: Pack published; shadow IC S1–S7 (computed seats, one debate round, minority reports).

nodes.label: PREVOTE_LOCK

nodes.sublabel: human meeting H1–H6 (T)

nodes.label: ESCALATE

nodes.detail: ESCALATE is reachable from every state and pauses only the requesting worker.

nodes.output: Flags packs where a card lacks priced_on, derives from a reverse stress, or breaks a politics rule

nodes.sublabel: ≥ 3 families target, ≤ 40% per family; never vote
nodes.output: Arguments, cruxes, minority reports; no numbers outside placeholders
nodes.detail: §7.3 lists ×12 narrators for the twelve §8.5 seats; brief §8 rule 1 adds a Real Assets seat (not yet reflected in ARCHITECTURE.md). With fewer than three approved families, same-family seats are treated as correlated and the family mix is disclosed (§7.10).

nodes.label: AnthropicBackend (live)
nodes.sublabel: live mode; needs only an API key or provider client
nodes.detail: client.messages.parse with adaptive thinking, explicit effort per role, strict tool schemas, no sampling parameters, no prefill; the manifest records the model that served each call.

nodes.label: ReplayBackend
nodes.sublabel: keyed by SHA-256 of the request; any miss raises
nodes.detail: Responses keyed by SHA-256 of the canonical request (model, system, tools, messages, parameters). Opus 5.5 accepts no sampling parameters, so replay is the only route to deterministic agent tests; CI runs a full offline campaign on Replay.

nodes.label: StubBackend
nodes.sublabel: seeded, schema-valid, rule-based outputs (offline)
nodes.detail: E.g. DSL-grammar sampling. In offline mode the Stub serves every role; without LLM access only narrative is lost and every number is unchanged.

nodes.label: LLM providers
nodes.sublabel: Anthropic API; Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry channels
nodes.detail: Family A claude-opus-5-5; Phase-0 family B claude-sonnet-5-5 (same provider, so 'correlated'). Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are deployment channels, not families; a second vendor is a Phase-1 addition.

nodes.label: Untrusted documents
nodes.sublabel: GP notices, memos, HF terms: data, never instructions

nodes.label: TB6 untrusted documents
nodes.sublabel: quarantined extractors, dual extraction, human sample

nodes.label: evaluator (search)
nodes.sublabel: python -I, no network; hash check; counts every call
nodes.detail: Verifies engine, config, scenario, belief and snapshot hashes against the contract on every request (mismatch → ABORTED). Deterministically rejects malformed, duplicate, out-of-bounds, non-finite and over-budget submissions and counts every call, failures and retries included. EvalRequest names a spec hash and optional tuning job, with no fields for metrics, seeds, worlds or path counts. Agent view of EvalResult: {correct, ΔΨ bucket, gate categories, promotable, budget_left}. Refuses tuning for kind = ablation.

nodes.label: Evaluator tool catalogue
nodes.sublabel: typed MCP tools (stdio); search + exploration only
nodes.detail: Strict JSON Schema, additionalProperties: false. The evaluator MCP server cannot reach the final plane, the sealed truth or a write path to engines, beliefs or scenarios.

nodes.label: Plane caches
nodes.sublabel: key = hash(source, snapshot, runtime, plane)
nodes.detail: A miss or mismatch stops evaluation and never triggers silent recomputation; each plane has its own cache.

nodes.label: Gate 1 correct (G4)
nodes.sublabel: TR1–TR8, T1–T9 bands, floor, NI ≥ −5bp, OV, duals
nodes.detail: Search and final planes, engine-side inputs only: (a) DSL type rules TR1–TR8; (b) hard rows T1–T5, T8 on every path (glide path in recovery), failed paths scored worst-case; (c) T6, T7, T9 within class bands (search point estimate ≤ 0.8 × tolerance at 10k paths; final one-sided 95% CP bound ≤ tolerance); (d) Tier-1B floor; (e) non-inferiority ≥ −5bp CE vs HOLD, or the restored Phase-II baseline in recovery; (f) OV1–OV3; (g) no pinned dual; (h) no gambling signature; (i) within budget.

nodes.label: Gate 2 selection (G5)
nodes.sublabel: ΔΨ − 2 SE > ε_mat vs incumbent; ties keep incumbent
nodes.detail: Search plane, paired CRN; Ψ_τ soft-min over worlds, τ = 0.5pp; ε_mat (CE bp a year): overlay 3, pacing 5, REFI/LEVER 10, SELL and other irreversible actions 15.

nodes.label: Engines L0–L7 (read-only)
nodes.sublabel: scen/state/owner/priv/pub/overlay/beliefs/ledger/core
nodes.detail: contracts/rng, data/synth, scen/state/owner, priv/pub/overlay/actions, beliefs/bridge, ledger, core (sim, h, safety…) and icm, robust/attrib/stats. Read-only, content-hashed engines, scenarios, beliefs and cost models (P2); engines never import lab, agents, claims or idm.

nodes.label: Real Assets interim engine
nodes.sublabel: added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)
nodes.badge: added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)
nodes.detail: Interim, until research G10–G15 lands: closed-end real-asset funds reuse the PE-fund commitment engine with real-asset parameters, including earlier income distributions; core, open-end and direct assets use income yield plus an appraisal-smoothed NAV driven by cap or discount rates, smoothed Geltner-style; capex and development calls; asset-level non-recourse debt with LTV, DSCR, a maturity wall, refinancing risk and rate hedges; open-end funds get a redemption-queue state machine analogous to the hedge-fund liquidity-terms machine. Energy and natural-resource assets are wrong-way with the owner's draw (weak oil raises the draw and lowers those assets). The group taxonomy is configuration, not code.

nodes.label: seal service (tpa seal)
nodes.sublabel: 256-bit salt; commits SHA256(salt ‖ contract_hash)
nodes.owner: MRM; seal custody by CRO office
nodes.detail: Holds the per-campaign 256-bit salt; writes SHA256(salt ‖ contract_hash) at signing; spawns 'tpa evaluator serve --plane final' once with HMAC(salt, world) spawn keys; reveals the salt after the run. No network; writes only the sealed final store.

nodes.label: evaluator (final)
nodes.sublabel: spawned once with HMAC(salt, world) keys; own cache

nodes.label: Gate 3 qualification (G6)
nodes.sublabel: Holm LCB95 > ε_mat; PBO ≤ 0.20; MDE ≤ ε_mat
nodes.detail: Final plane, once: correct on the final plane; Holm-adjusted LCB95(ΔΨ vs comparator, base mixture) > ε_mat; LCB95(ΔJ_m) > −5bp in every world; LCB95(ΔJ_m) > 0 in ≥ 2 worlds, one of them B2; PBO ≤ 0.20 (CSCV, ≥ 8 structural blocks); MDE ≤ ε_mat, else NOT_ASSESSED.

nodes.sublabel: planted gain, leak, null: power ≥ 0.8, false-Q ≤ 5%

nodes.sublabel: Register compiler, briefs, shadow-IC compute, pack

notes: Motto: LLMs accelerate evidence; deterministic models own numbers; humans own decisions. Nothing executes trades (§0.1; brief P1).
Processes: tpa lab run (only egress), tpa evaluator serve --plane search (no network), tpa seal under the CRO account, tpa room (no network) (§7.2).
Trust boundaries: TB1 data perimeter, TB2 evaluator, TB3 LLM egress, TB4 seal, TB5 decision, TB6 untrusted documents, TB7 synthetic vs real, TB8 truth seal (§2.4).
The evaluator checks engine, config, scenario, belief and snapshot hashes on every request; a mismatch moves the campaign to ABORTED; a cache miss stops evaluation (§7.2).
Agents see rounded ΔΨ buckets, gate categories and budget left; humans and the auditor see the full ledger (§7.2; §10.4).
Meta-controller gates: G0 contract; G1 design review; G2 freeze; G3 admissibility (schema, DSL compile, novelty); G4–G6 = engine gates 1–3; G7 brief; G8 audit; G9 record (§7.6).

Failure taxonomy: INVALID_SPEC, TIER1_FAIL, FLOOR_FAIL, NI_FAIL, OV_FAIL, PINNED_DUAL, GAMBLING, BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, EXECUTION_FAILED; NOT_PROMOTED; QUALIFIED, NOT_QUALIFIED, NOT_CORRECT, NOT_ASSESSED (§7.6).
Agent-verified rubrics are diagnostics and stopping rules only; a QUALIFIED label never substitutes for the ballot (§7.6).
Engine faults retry under their own budget as degraded phases, shown and never passed silently; candidate-caused failures count as evaluations (§7.4).
Search results are never claims: over ≈40 tests, P(at least one false promotion) ≈ 60% (§7.7).
Memory is a per-campaign search heuristic: closed at SELECTION, archived at CLOSED, never cross-campaign; institutional memory lives in the forecast registry and decision log (§7.8; ADR-33).
Cross-family review: reviewer, filter, red team, auditor and AI validator run on family B; Phase 0 same-provider reviews are labelled 'correlated', never extremized (§7.10; ADR-30).
Admission tests before a role is trusted: judges κ ≥ 0.6 on ≥ 50 golden items; auditor ≥ 90% recall; translator pass³ ≥ 0.9; sycophancy < 10% unjustified flips (§7.10).
Offline first: engines, evaluator, the room's deterministic parts and all tests run with no network; CI runs a full offline campaign on Replay (§7.13; §11.1).
Laptop isolation relies on NTFS ACLs and separate Windows accounts; weaker than service accounts or containers, and disclosed (§7.2; §11.7).
Real Assets (added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)): the group taxonomy is configuration, not code; an interim Real Assets engine joins priv (brief §8 rules 1–2).

nodes.badge: added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)
nodes.detail: Eighth investment group: real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources (agriculture and timber excluded); funds plus co-investments and direct assets or joint ventures; inside the ~60% private allocation. nodes.label: Decision Register
nodes.sublabel: signed YAML → DecisionType; Q1–Q10, A1–A9, E1–E4
nodes.detail: Each entry declares proposer → decider, tier, cadence and deadline, variables, the options it must always show (status quo, DEFER, recommendation, archetypes A/B/C), signpost rules and an evidence contract of EvidenceSpec(metric, by, plane, max_age_days). nodes.label: L1 briefs
nodes.sublabel: one page each; ≤ 6 pages per Tier-A item
nodes.detail: Fixed anatomy: (1) question, deadline, decider, recusals; (2) options: status quo, DEFER, recommendation, alternatives; (3) consequences: ΔTier-1 by class with CP bounds, ΔJ, Δsurvival months, ΔP(10%) reported only; (4) economics: λ-priced waterfall, binding constraints, shadow prices, envelope use, priced_on, Γ; (5) beliefs: raw vs fused marks, market anchor, information value; (6) disagreement: implied-action map, belief/value split, minority reports (authentic first); (7) what would change it: flip thresholds, signposts, cross-fitted EVSI when DEFER is live.

nodes.label: L0 fund on a page
nodes.sublabel: ≤ 5 min: CFP, Tier-1, draw, λ/FTP, WYNTB, lab block

nodes.label: L2 drill-down

nodes.label: Console (W1–W3)
nodes.sublabel: HTML/JSON pack with ep.js; cruxes shown at H2
nodes.detail: The pack embeds 10,000 paths × ≈40 metrics and a ≤ 150-line vanilla-JS dual-Newton solver that runs golden cases against Python on load and disables W1 on any mismatch > 10⁻⁶.

nodes.label: Status quo, DEFER, A/B/C
nodes.sublabel: frozen archetypes through module F, on CRN
nodes.detail: A: de-risking by secondary sales; B: synthetic DPI via REFINANCE (cash-out) plus tail monetization; C: opportunistic alpha expansion. Shown with ΔCE, P(red) by class, Δsurvival and P(10%) beside P(red); a materially projected archetype is labelled 'Tier-1 infeasible as specified'. NOT_QUALIFIED / NOT_ASSESSED recommendations keep their label and the validator blocks improvement verbs.

nodes.label: AI Validator (family B)
nodes.sublabel: flags missing priced_on, reverse-stress cards, politics
nodes.detail: Non-voting; sits outside the twelve seats.

nodes.label: Pack linter + visual grammar
nodes.sublabel: central [range] ± MC, ICD-203 word, plane label
nodes.detail: Every probability as '37% [26–38%] ± 0.2pp' with scenario hash, ICD-203 word and plane label (SEALED / SEARCH / EXPLORATORY); greyed when |Δ| < 2 paired SE; P(10%) always beside P(red); SYNTHETIC footer when tainted; rejects cross-group league tables and any blueprint illustrative figure.

nodes.label: Admissible value set Θ
nodes.sublabel: γ∈[2,6], λ_T∈[0,2], T6 ≤ IC tolerance; no indicators
nodes.detail: Shortfall exponent ≥ 1; a T6 limit no looser than the IC's tolerance; extra costs only on engine metrics; no indicator or probability terms. The blueprint's opposing institutional utilities survive here, but no seat maximizes P(10%).

nodes.sublabel: q: group's filed forecasts · θ: γ 3, λ_T 1, 1% + loss
nodes.detail: Five private-group heads, Public Markets, Overlay (two briefs: convexity per unit of carry; deflated alpha and margin). Mandate loss terms: κ^GP; dry-powder value; concentration; PIK/kicker; LGD ambiguity; adverse selection; hedge fatigue and hidden short vol. Named by mandate ('PE mandate (AI seat)'), never as people.

nodes.sublabel: added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)
nodes.badge: added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)

nodes.label: Outside-View Forecaster
nodes.sublabel: q: reference-class priors only · θ: γ 3, λ_T 1, 1%

nodes.label: Red Team seat
nodes.sublabel: q: minimum-KL failure world vs the recommendation
nodes.detail: Objective devil's advocate; output labelled 'assigned dissent', aimed at the model recommendation and, after H1, at the human majority.

nodes.label: implied_actions
nodes.sublabel: a*_k = argmax J(a; q_k, θ_k) over A_T1 (W2 paths)
nodes.detail: Numbers come only from the engine (test_seat_numbers_only_from_implied_actions); regret R_k(a) = J(a*_k) − J(a) under the seat's beliefs and values.

nodes.label: Regret + Shapley split
nodes.sublabel: belief → diligence (EVSI); value → delegation chain
nodes.detail: Decision-relevant disagreement = average regret of the committee's action; group disagreement shown as the information value of the group's forecast in $; diversity alarm if pairwise seat rank correlation > 0.9; recused positions leave the pool.

nodes.label: Seat narrators (LLM)
nodes.sublabel: argue, rank cruxes; probabilities = agent judgment
nodes.detail: ≥ 3 families target, ≤ 40% per family; never vote; no numbers outside placeholders; any probability they state is labelled 'agent judgment' and never pooled with model outputs.

nodes.label: Facilitator (non-voting)
nodes.sublabel: protocol state only; introduces no claims

nodes.label: Seat protocol S0–S7
nodes.sublabel: frozen Qs, hashed S1, cruxes, 1 round, influence cap
nodes.detail: S0 8–15 frozen questions per Tier-A item; S1 independent hashed assessments; S2 reveal with cruxes ranked by value of information; S3 one debate round by default with an influence cap (a move > 5pp needs a new validated artifact); S4 pre-mortem and competing hypotheses on the DPI decline; S5–S7 hashed minority reports, authentic dissent first.

nodes.label: Minority reports
nodes.sublabel: |Δp| ≥ 15pp or regret ≥ 10bp CE; authentic first

nodes.label: Agenda (180 min)
nodes.sublabel: A total 40 · B group blocks 90 · C cross 20 · D ballot 30
nodes.detail: A total portfolio (Q1–Q4); B group blocks ordered by decision value at stake (minimax regret in $ + EVSI) and the marginal-asset agenda; C cross-group (internal transfers, desk quotes via the pricing committee, P2S/HF-TRS collateral, overlay offset card); D ballot. At most four Tier-A items per meeting.

nodes.label: Real Assets block + cards
nodes.sublabel: added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)
nodes.badge: added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)
nodes.detail: Group block B and group-keyed Register items (Q4 envelopes and FTP charges, Q5 pacing by group, Q6 cards) are generic over groups. Interim action set: SELL = asset or stake sale, secondary sale of a fund LP interest, open-end redemption subject to the queue; HOLD; REFINANCE (cash-out) = cash-out refinancing of asset-level debt, recap, sale-leaseback or ground lease, JV or partial-stake sell-down, NAV facility on real-asset fund interests; LEVER (exposure-up) = asset-level acquisition or development debt. Asset-level debt is non-recourse and outside Corporate Finance's facilities, but counts in look-through leverage and in stress through refinancing risk and covenant cures. Oil wrong-way risk with the owner's draw applies to the energy and natural-resource book. Interactions: Private Credit, Capital Solutions, Overlay, Secondaries, Corporate Finance.

nodes.label: Consent agenda
nodes.sublabel: P(best) ≥ 0.8 in every class; any member may pull
nodes.detail: Also requires no minority-report trigger, minimax regret ≤ materiality and no Board trigger.

nodes.label: H0 blind pre-vote
nodes.sublabel: fact pack only; locked and hashed at T−1
nodes.detail: No AI narrative, seat map or minority reports before the pre-vote.

nodes.label: H1 reveal

nodes.label: H3 pre-mortem
nodes.sublabel: rotating human devil's advocate

nodes.sublabel: approve / resize / defer / reject; second-chance

nodes.label: Minutes Drafter (LLM)
nodes.sublabel: read_ballots, structured transcript; draft only

nodes.label: Decision rules
nodes.sublabel: pooled (reversible); minimax regret (irreversible)
nodes.detail: Max-min only as a diagnostic. DEFER only if the 80% lower bound of cross-fitted EVSI exceeds the cost of delay, no staged action dominates and fewer than 2 prior deferrals. A discursive-dilemma flag is raised when the pooled answer differs from the vote.

nodes.label: Q&A Answerer (Ask)

nodes.detail: Labels: model output / agent judgment / assumption; 'not in the artifacts' is valid.

nodes.label: Translator (NL → typed)
nodes.sublabel: FBE and entropy-pooling ViewSpec drafts; KL, ESS
nodes.detail: E.g. 'Buyout forecast 16% realizes at 8%, spreads +250bp' → an FBE ViewSpec plus an entropy-pooling ViewSpec; acts only after the member confirms.

nodes.label: Member confirms view
nodes.sublabel: effective view after target shrinkage (c = 0.6)
nodes.detail: At c = 0.6, 'distributions 30% below base' becomes 18% below.

nodes.label: W1 entropy pooling
nodes.sublabel: < 1 s in the pack; golden self-test; EXPLORATORY
nodes.detail: KL flags: inform > 0.05, warn > 0.25, amber > 1.20, red > 2.30 nats (forces W3); Kish ESS ≥ 5,000; weight ratio ≤ 50.

nodes.label: W2 re-fusion + re-opt
nodes.sublabel: ≤ 60 s on cached CRN paths; EXPLORATORY
nodes.detail: Asset-return and lever views become FBE signals (ω = (P90 − P10)/2.563 until the member is scored); a lever view also updates the bridge; W2 re-scores cards.

nodes.label: W3 re-simulation
nodes.sublabel: tilted sampler; confirmatory only on the sealed plane

nodes.label: Confirmatory sealed run
nodes.sublabel: before irreversible Tier-A on exploratory evidence

nodes.label: Decision log
nodes.sublabel: DecisionRecords: append-only, bitemporal, hashed
nodes.detail: DecisionRecord: decision_id, register_id, tier, options, engine_recommendation, evidence_plane, run_manifests, priced_on, consent_scenario, recovery_hash, prevote_hashes, ballots, decision, override reason code (belief, value, info_outside_model, implementation, legal_consent, relationship, other), rationale, minority_reports, signposts, commitment_plan, review_date, outcomes q1/q4/q8. Tracks plan consistency and DEFER frequency.

nodes.label: Signpost monitor
nodes.sublabel: alarm 0.5σ on safe side → Tier B; flip → Tier A
nodes.detail: Flip values by root-finding; alarms re-arm after a 0.25σ retreat.

nodes.label: Commitment plan
nodes.sublabel: pre-committed state-contingent actions
nodes.detail: Guards committee dynamic inconsistency.

nodes.label: Forecast registry
nodes.sublabel: WIS-scored; IC probabilities Brier-scored 1/4/8 q
nodes.detail: Append-only, bitemporal; one epistemology for every forecaster; Brier skill against the model measures the value of overrides.

nodes.label: Room evaluation
nodes.sublabel: shadow mode; hidden-profile accuracy; seeded errors
nodes.detail: 6–12 months of shadow mode; sycophancy and flip tests; seat-diversity alarm; time-sliced replay. KPIs: reliance split by model correctness, override accuracy, dissent rate, DEFER frequency, anti-portfolio returns, plan consistency, legitimacy survey. No persuasion optimization; one seeded-error drill per Tier-A meeting; a kill switch per item.

nodes.label: Decision rights A/B/C/Board
nodes.sublabel: machine-enforced tiers; recusal; irreversibility
nodes.detail: A: ≥ 0.25% of NAV, discount > 10%, LTV +5pp or leverage +1pp, tail budget > 10bp, opportunistic limits, conflicted transfers → majority + irreversibility protocol. B: CIO + CRO. C: group / desk. Board/owner items. CFP stage authorities: Green Treasurer, Amber CIO, Red IC weekly, Black Board and owner. Symmetric irreversibility needs a second-chance check and CRO sign-off; a head's vote on its own envelope is recorded but not tallied.

nodes.label: Politics rules (tests)
nodes.sublabel: information value not a grade; n_eff ≥ 20; no league
nodes.detail: Credibility is a weight on information; own reference class only; no league tables; symmetric WIS scoring; a forecast cannot buy budget; strategic bias modelled; a route to contest; FTP disputes by a CRO-office committee within 10 business days.

lanes.label: IC pack: L0 / L1 / L2 and console (pack)
Computed shadow IC: seats (q_k, θ_k ∈ Θ)

notes: Every engine output exists because a Register decision consumes it; the room asks the evidence compiler, which asks the evaluator, and never calls an engine directly (§3.2; ADR-22).
Register cadences: Q1–Q10 quarterly; A1–A9 annual, run in Q4; E1–E4 events on the compressed protocol; increment 1 ships Q1, Q2, Q4, Q5, Q6 (§8.2; §8.3).
No item reaches the ballot with an unmet evidence contract; a brief shows 'EVIDENCE MISSING: ⟨metric⟩' and is never filled silently (§8.2; §8.4).
§8.5 defines twelve seats (CIO, CRO, Treasurer/CF, five private-group heads, Public Markets, Overlay, Outside-View Forecaster, Red Team); the Facilitator and AI Validator sit outside them (§8.5).
Brief §8 rule 1 adds a Real Assets mandate seat to the §8.5 twelve; ARCHITECTURE.md is not yet updated for it (brief §8).
Seats are named by mandate, never as people; the pack never shows 'regret of the PE head'; AI seats compute and argue but never vote (§8.5; §0.3 rule 8).
Θ forbids indicator or probability terms, so no seat maximizes P(10%); any LLM-stated probability is 'agent judgment', never pooled with model outputs (§8.5; §3.3).
Symmetric irreversibility: forfeiting optionality with expected loss > 0.25% of NAV, including letting a bid or financing window lapse, needs a second-chance check and CRO sign-off (§8.1).
No neural surrogate number is ever shown; any W1 number entering the decision log is recomputed by the Python engine (§8.7; ADR-23).
Usability acceptance: L0 readable in ≤ 5 minutes; every number ≤ 2 clicks from its manifest; W1 < 1 s; pack published by T−7 (§8.4).
Between meetings, the standing policy and CFP playbooks act only as IC-approved delegated rules executed by named humans (§8.1; §5.9).
The IDM is itself an inventoried model, revalidated annually (A9); agents are blind to the chair's and CIO's preferences (§8.11).

Real Assets (added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)): head, seat, forecasts and group block follow the group-generic rules; open-end redemptions queue; asset-level debt is non-recourse and outside CF facilities (brief §8 rules 1–3).

lanes.label: Pricing, lab campaign and seal (T−20 to T−11)

notes: The IC meets on day T; gates G0–G9 are defined in §7.6 (§3.6).
The freeze (T−23) precedes the contract check (T−22) because Phase I needs the frozen state (§7.4).
The lab campaign is optional each quarter; when disabled, only C_H and the incumbent go forward to the sealed run (§3.6; §7.4).
C_H (H's quarter-1 package followed by P0) is always a finalist, so the IC is never without a sealed verdict on the optimizer's recommendation (§7.4).
Final-plane seeds are committed at T−22 and the final plane runs once at T−12; the salt is revealed after the run (§7.2; §7.5).
Pack published by T−7; no item reaches the ballot with an unmet evidence contract (§8.4).
A1–A9 run in the Q4 cycle; event decisions (E1–E4, and Q8 on dealing dates) use the compressed protocol on EXPLORATORY W2 evidence (§8.3).
Between quarters the standing policy and CFP playbooks act only as IC-approved delegated rules executed by named humans; nothing self-executes (§5.9; ADR-32).

Real Assets (added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8)) files at T−25 like every group; its holdings get interim-action-set cards at T−20 and its mandate seat joins at T−7 (brief §8 rules 1, 3).
